_comment: The mutation gate. Scope, threshold and runner are asserted by mutation.config.test.ts; docs/testing.md explains what a surviving mutant means and how to read the report.
_thresholds_comment: break is a RATCHET, set at the measured baseline (82.74 over three runs, 2026-08-02), not at an aspiration. 82 leaves 0.74 of slack because 5 mutants are killed by timeout and a timeout is a wall-clock judgement, not a deterministic one. Raise this as survivors are killed; never lower it.
